title: Optimal ROI and fiducial design for the next LZ high-energy analysis: trading fiducial mass against MSSI with a 3D likelihood
question: For the 200-400 keV NR search, which stand-off s, bottom cut z_b and S1c edge maximise discovery sensitivity given surface-concentrated wall/RFR MSSI and a uniform signal; is LZ's 8 cm stand-off optimal or a low-energy legacy; what does a position (soft-FV) likelihood add; what 5 sigma exposure follows for the untouched data?
headline_result: LZ's 8 cm stand-off is within 0.1% of the Asimov optimum for the 200-423 keV window (flat to 1% over 3.5-10 cm at a 1000 phd edge); the edge, not the FV, carries the gain: 1000 phd raises P(5 sigma | best fit) in the untouched 524 live days from 0.43 to 0.83 (L10) and 1.00 (delta = 366 keV), and a position likelihood is worth +16-20% effective mass; LZ's own MSSI table implies a wall profile lambda = 1.2 cm, 7x steeper than P033's 4.3 cm, so stand-offs <= 6 cm are only safe with a position-dependent likelihood
key_numbers: 1000 phd: signal x1.89/3.0/6.3 (L10/d350/d366), b 8.9e-4 -> 8.0e-3 per 524 d, Z 5.73 -> 6.95/9.1/14.1, 5 sigma at 272/158/66 live d (LZ cuts 399); Z(s) peak s=1 cm (600 phd, 5.92 vs 5.73) / 6.5 cm (1000 phd, 6.955 vs 6.946); z_b 9->5 costs 2.5% at 1000 phd; mass 0.155 t/cm (s), 0.033 t/cm (z_b), calibration x1.104 -> 4.71 & 5.42 t; LZ-table lambda 1.23 cm (HE-SB 1.36), lambda_z 2.0 cm, leakage 0.50 cm; worst-case b at s=6/5: 0.064/0.16; 3D likelihood 7.47 vs 6.90 (5.45 t equiv.), 7.61 at s=6 (5.65 t), 7.8-7.9 under lambda 1.2; 5.5 t kept: dZ -0.26..+0.21, reach x1.12; 3-event 5 sigma needs b <= 0.012; reco floor d_reco >= 3 cm reached at s = 4.8 cm
model_or_mechanism: FV families from P070's digitised Fig. 3 contour (shift/cylinder/reco-margin); wall MSSI int exp(-(R-r)/lambda) dV and RFR int exp(-z/lambda_z) dV normalised to LZ's MSSI table with the 5.4 t annulus as calibration; P038 edge-dependent MSSI x 0.15; uniform 2e-4 x mass; P050 WimPyDD spectra with P038 erf efficiencies; Asimov Z, exact-Poisson P(5 sigma), (d,z)-binned soft-FV likelihood
result_type: computed (geometry, integrals, Z, Poisson metrics) / estimated (MSSI extension, profile bracket)
confidence: medium - optimum location robust across metrics and profiles; absolute rates rest on P038's MSSI interpolation and the lambda bracket 1.2-6 cm
